message.content: The pain started about eight days ago in my left upper belly. It was mild at first, but it's gotten worse. I was told it was a stomach bug, but it never got better. I don't remember details about whether it's sharp or cramping, or if it spreads anywhere, and I can't give you an exact number out of 10. Now I'm also feeling sick to my stomach and throwing up. I haven't had a drinking binge. I don't drink alcohol at all. About the vomiting, I don't know about keeping fluids down, blood in the vomit, black stools or fever, because none of that was mentioned. I'm also about five weeks pregnant. I had a positive home test and I've missed my period.
